messages:
maria: Heads-up — planned maintenance tonight 23:00–01:00 UTC (US-West, EU-Central). Kernel/runtime upgrade for dedicated pools. We'll pin model promotions and enable fallback routing for affected routes. Expect short latency blips, no planned data-plane downtime.

deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled by maria at 1763123456. Canary starts 23:05 UTC on ded-gpu-us-west. Full rollout at ~23:20 if canary passes. Targets: ded-gpu-us-west, ded-gpu-eu-central.

sam: Pushing customer comms suggestions here. Keep language short and actionable. Also calling out rollback criteria: >2% error rate sustained for 5m OR p95 latency +200ms.

jess: +1 to criteria. Add a line assuring: "no data storage or model data changes".

maria: OK — draft status & SMS below. Please review quickly; we'll publish 1 hour before window.

Statuspage draft (short):
Scheduled maintenance: Routine runtime upgrade in US-West and EU-Central on DATE at 23:00–01:00 UTC. We expect no customer-facing downtime; some requests may experience brief latency increases or automatic fallbacks to alternative capacity. Model promotions will be temporarily pinned during the window. We'll post updates here and on https://status.redwood.ai.

SMS/Short broadcast (for SMS/SEMs):
Redwood: Routine maintenance tonight 23:00–01:00 UTC. Minimal impact expected. Monitor https://status.redwood.ai for live updates.

Customer-facing longer note (for customers requiring detail):
We will perform a kernel and runtime upgrade on our dedicated inference pools to deploy performance and reliability improvements. During the window we will temporarily pin model promotions and activate fallback routing for critical endpoints. No customer data changes are performed. If you have workloads that are latency-sensitive to the millisecond, consider scheduling outside the window or reach out to support.

Operational checklist for oncall (short):
- Preflight by 22:15: ensure latest smoke images, warm KV caches for canary models.
- Canary @23:05: run smoke tests (text generation, embeddings quick-run).
- Monitor p50/p95 latency, 5m error rate, token throughput.
- Criteria to HOLD/ROLLBACK: >2% 5m error rate OR p95 latency +200ms OR token drop >15% sustained 5m.
- If canary fails, hold rollout and rollback canary with `/rollback --target=ded-gpu-us-west` and notify support.

Example ops commands (for reference):
```
# start canary
/deploy --cluster=ded-gpu-us-west --release=runtime-2024-03-12 --canary=true --models=redwood-**
# promote
/deploy --promote --clusters=ded-gpu-us-west,ded-gpu-eu-central --batch=staggered
# rollback
/rollback --target=ded-gpu-us-west --reason="canary-errors"
```

ryan_oncall: Acknowledged. I will run preflight at 22:15 and post a green check before canary. Planning to run these quick smoke commands after canary: `curl -s https://internal-smoke/api/generate?prompt=smoke` and a short embedding compare.

sam: I'll stage the statuspage publish at 22:00 and SMS blast at 22:30 (customers in affected regions). Copy below is final unless objections: short status + link.

jess: Quick nit: change "pin model promotions" -> "temporarily pause automatic promotions". Otherwise :thumbsup:.

maria: Updated the status copy accordingly. If no objections by 22:00 we'll publish. Thanks all — ping here for any last-minute holds.
